newsitem.title: UK: Br Gas demerger - snapshot of BG Plc.
newsitem.headline: Br Gas demerger - snapshot of BG Plc.

text.p: British Gas Plc plans to split into two companies early next year. The following is a snapshot of BG Plc, which will remain after flotation of the Centrica UK gas supply company.
BG Plc, with David Varney as chief executive, will own and operate the UK gas pipeline and storage system (Transco).

It will retain the British Gas oil and gas exploration and production businesses -- excluding its Morecombe Bay gas fields -- along with its international downstream, research and techology businesses and its property activities.

A key determinant of the revenue BG's Transco business generates will be the level of price control set by industry regulator Ofgas, an issue which is currently the subject of an inquiry by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.

This throws into uncertainty the level of dividend payable by BG, the company said. It intends the exploration and production and international downstream operations to be self-financing and that Transco's net current cost profit should be dedicated to paying BG's dividend.
A final decision on BG's dividend, which will be lower than the planned total 1996 British Gas Plc dividend of 14.5p, will be made subsequent to the MMC inquiry.
